name: Yahoo Finance
description: Equity, ETF and index quotes, OHLC history, symbol search, quarterly statements, market news and dividend and split dates from Yahoo Finance's public web interfaces.
terms: Yahoo Finance chart, search and fundamentals endpoints are unofficial public interfaces without a published API contract. They are not guaranteed real-time and may change or be rate limited without notice. Verify currency, fiscal period and Yahoo's terms of use before relying on the data.
